messages:
ingrid: Customer report — tool_function call failing when args contain backticks + emoji. Customer sees 400 Invalid JSON: "Unexpected token ` in JSON at position 58". Repro attached.

alec: Can you paste the raw request body they sent?

ingrid: Here's the raw body captured from their proxy:
```
{tool: 'run_code', args: {script: `console.log(`hello ${name}`) 😅`, note: 'inline `code` example'},}
```
This is what the gateway forwarded (note: trailing comma, unquoted keys, template backticks)

sophie: That explains it — this is not JSON. They used JS object literal / template literal instead of JSON.stringify. Backticks and unquoted keys will break any strict JSON parser.

ingrid: Confirmed with customer stack trace:
```
Error: Unexpected token ` in JSON at position 58
    at JSON.parse (<anonymous>)
    at parseArgs (/srv/runtime/parser.js:42:15)
```

alec: Recommended fix for customer: send JSON.stringify(payload) and set Content-Type: application/json. Quick repro snippet:
```
const payload = {tool: 'run_code', args: {script: 'console.log(`hi`) 😅', note: 'inline `code` example'}};
await fetch(url, {method: 'POST', headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify(payload)});
```

sophie: We should harden the API error message. Propose returning 400 with hint when parser fails on non-quote token (e.g., "looks like a JS literal/template; try JSON.stringify"). I'll open a PR.

support-bot: Escalation created: INC-2024-142 (P2) — assigned to eng-runtime.

ingrid: Customer accepted the workaround and patched client. They've hit prod once more and it's green. I'll keep this open until PR lands.

alec: Thx. Add an SDK guard in JS SDK to auto-JSON.stringify if user passes plain object for args.

sophie: Filed follow-ups: GH-981 (server hint), GH-982 (js-sdk stringify guard). Closing after QA.

ingrid: Confirmed resolution with customer; closing from our side once GH-981 merged. :white_check_mark:
